newsitem.title: JAPAN: Applications for JR West shares total 6,445,073.
newsitem.headline: Applications for JR West shares total 6,445,073.

text.p: West Japan Railway Co (JR West) said on Friday that the final number of share applications for JR West's fixed price offer totalled 6,445,073.
The number of share applications originally totalled 7,070,368 but some decided to cancel their applications by the deadline of September 3.
Out of the 1.7 million shares JR West is selling to investors, 950,000 shares will be sold through the fixed price offer. The other 750,000 shares were auctioned on August 27.
JR West will be listed on the Tokyo and other Japanese stock exchanges on October 8.
